title: 188 L Direct Cool Refrigerator 5 Star Cherry Blossom Wine
category: Home Appliances > Refrigerators > Direct Cool Refrigerator
key_features: Inverter Compressor : Inverter compressor helps maintain a stable temperature inside refrigerator for longer freshness and while consuming less energy
Home Inverter Connect : It automatically connects to your home inverter during power failures,ensuring consistent cooling and helping maintain freshness for longer without any worries

Rapid Freeze Technology : The Hybrid Evaporator (Freezer) with a Powerful Compressor, Thicker PUFF Insulation, and a Quartz-Coated Alloy Ice Tray in the Lloyd Direct Cool Refrigerator delivers superfast cooling, making ice in 29 minutes
Bactshield : Bactshield technology prevents up to 99 %* of bacterial growth and gives long-lasting freshness to your food

Viruzsafe : Special coating on Refrigerator handle kills bacteria, 100+ microbes and 99 % viruses. Regular handles can harbor viruses and bacteria, but this coated handle prevents their unintentional spread
Honeycomb Crisper : The crisper cover is designed in a way that it locks moisture in your veggies and fruits, and helps maintain the optimum humidity for longer freshness
Fleximax Design : Adjustable glass shelves to help you use space inside the refrigerator efficiently according to your needs and provide multiple storage spaces for items of different shapes & sizes

Concealed Capillary & Suction (CCS) : The concealed capillary & suction technology enhances cooling by keeping the refrigerants in the body of the refrigerator. It improves the cooling efficiency of Lloyd refrigerators
